relationships.subject: Resveratrol
relationships.evidence_quote: Nonetheless, an injection of RESV regulated the alterations by inhibiting TRPV4.

relationships.subject: Streptozotocin
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased current density in the DRGs carried on by STZ is attributed to the TRPV4, according to the present electrophysiological data.

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: The stimulation of TRPV4 resulted in an increase in Ca2+ signaling and mtROS pathways, which in turn generated DPN.

key_findings: Resveratrol reduced STZ-induced TRPV4 current density, Ca2+ influx, ROS, caspases and mechanical/thermal neuropathic pain in mouse DRG.
TRPV4 antagonist ruthenium red mimicked resveratrol protective effects.
